craft_notes: Sthāyin: Resting in dependence (nirvṛti). Em-dash→comma (working softens onto hanging). Rejected: 'dangle' for 'hang' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Lord, in slumber e'en whatso I work or word, foul or fair,
prideful hang I on thee — at home in all, content.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nātha svapne 'pi yat kuryāṃ brūyāṃ vā sādhv asādhu vā tvadadhīnatvadarpeṇa sarvatrātrāsmi nirvṛtaḥ

reads_against.argmap: O lord, even in dream whatever I may do or say, good or bad. → Dependent-pride makes every dream act content.
c1_essence: Dream doings foul or fair rested glad in dependence-pride.
reads_against.l2: Lord, in dreams too, do or utter I foul or fair — proud to hang on you — at home in all places I rest glad.
l3: Lord, in slumber e'en whatso I work or word, foul or fair —
prideful hang I on thee — at home in all, content.
reads_against.t1: O lord, even in dream whatever I may do or say, good or bad — with pride of dependence on you — everywhere here I am content.
